ruleName: Ball moved when taking a practice swing
imagePrompt: A teenage golfer on the fairway accidentally brushing and moving their golf ball while attempting a practice swing.
imageAlt: Teen golfer brushing the ball with a club on a practice swing on fairway.

issues: Could emphasize the action of the ball being brushed or just moved more clearly to suit the prompt, but all visual golf details are accurate.
imageVerification.repairPrompt: Show the golf ball very slightly displaced with a subtle visible trace or motion blur towards its new position, and depict a wisp of grass or brush motion near the ball to make it clearer the ball was moved accidentally during the practice swing.

questions.title: If your ball moves when you practise your swing, what should you do?
questions.question: You are on the fairway and you accidentally touch your ball with your club during a practice swing. The ball rolls away. What should you do?

choices.text: Hit the ball from where it stopped.
Put your ball back to where it was and add 1 extra shot.
Move the ball to a place you like more.

questions.explanation: If you make your ball move during a practice swing, you must put the ball back where it was and add 1 extra shot to your score.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: Swinging your club to get ready, but not hitting the real shot.
The short grass area that leads to the hole.
An extra shot added to your score as a penalty.

questions.teachingTip: Show a simple demonstration of a practice swing and what to do if the ball moves. Use cones or a coin to mark where the ball started.
likelyMisconceptions: Children may think they can play the ball from its new spot.
Children might forget to add a penalty stroke.
Children might think they can move the ball to anywhere else.

questions.title: What happens if you move your ball on a practice swing?
questions.question: On the fairway, you accidentally move your ball by brushing it during a practice swing. What should you do?

choices.text: Play the ball from where it moved to.
Replace the ball and add 1 penalty stroke.
Move the ball to a place you like better.

questions.explanation: You must return the ball to its original spot and add 1 penalty stroke if you move it while making a practice swing.
